classification_policy.automatic_authority: False unless an allowed identity/successor evidence object supplies source, fragment, date scope, and target entity.
classification_policy.code_resolution: Member codes resolve only to current catalog IDs; no names or normalized names create authority.
classification_policy.historical_identity: Code resolution is not proof that a 1900 historical entity is the current catalog entity.
classification_policy.successor_relation: Successor or sovereignty relations require explicit date-scoped entity-specific evidence.
